# Contract: Trends Action

<!-- Generated by Spec-Kit /speckit.plan | Session: a0048076-0ae1-42e8-b25c-9d53f1b17c55 | Date: 2026-01-26 -->

## Overview

Analyzes all archived sessions to generate trend report showing patterns over time (FR-005, FR-015).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `-Action` | string | Yes | - | Must be "Trends" |
| `-Days` | int | No | 30 | Number of days to analyze |
| `-FeatureBranch` | string | No | - | Filter by specific branch |

## Behavior

1. Load all archives from `archive/` directory
2. Filter by date range and feature branch
3. Filter out legacy schema (< 2.0.0)
4. Calculate trends for:
   - Tokens per session (increasing/decreasing)
   - Success rate (improving/declining)
   - Average duration (faster/slower)
   - Model usage distribution changes
   - Parallelization efficiency
5. Generate insights:
   - Flag increasing token usage (>20% increase)
   - Highlight improved success rates
   - Note efficiency regressions
6. Display formatted report

```text

  2026-01-22  implement (001)      88.5%          ↑ improving
  2026-01-24  implement (002)      92.0%          ↑ improving

```

## Preconditions

- At least 2 archived sessions with schema version 2.0.0+

## Postconditions

- Report displayed (not persisted)

## Example

```powershell
.\agent-metrics.ps1 -Action Trends -Days 14 -FeatureBranch "001-feature"
```

## Error Handling

| Error | Behavior |
|-------|----------|
| No archives found | Exit with "No archived sessions found" |
| All archives are legacy | Exit with "No v2.0.0+ sessions available for trend analysis" |
| < 2 valid sessions | Warning: "Limited data for trend analysis" |
